entries.zh: 探听；打听、探察消息底细
entries.en: to examine; to find out by inquiry; to probe (for news or secrets)

entries.zh: 察看动静；观察其动向（首字字形存疑，或作「看」）
entries.en: to examine by observing it — to watch its movements/whereabouts
entries.notes: 汉字首字「省/看」存疑；据西语 mirándolo 与闽音 cuã（看）判为「看/省动静」

entries.en: to examine by searching; to search out and inspect

entries.zh: 考经；考问经文、试经义（或指考问教义经课）
entries.en: to examine in the classics/scripture; to test by questioning on the (classic or sacred) texts
entries.notes: 西语词头 el reyno（王国）与「考經」不对应，疑为讹读；据汉字与闽音 co queng 判为考经

entries.zh: 考看会袂；考察能不能、验看可否（首字字形存疑，或作「看」）
entries.en: to examine whether it is fit/capable or not
entries.notes: 汉字「省/看」存疑；「會袂」（能/不能）与西语 si es para ello, o no 相合

entries.zh: 检有伤；查验有无损伤、破坏
entries.en: to examine whether it has damage; to inspect for injury or corruption
to examine the wounds; to inspect (injuries)
to examine the corpse; to inspect the wounds of the dead
to perform an inquest; to examine the wounds of the dead

entries.zh: 仵作；官府中验尸之吏役（又作件作）
entries.en: coroner; the official inquest officer (wuzuo) who examines corpses
entries.notes: 汉字「仵/件」存疑；闽音栏内 l gLas, mira xellama asi 为西语旁注（mira, se llama así＝「如此称呼」），非词条音读

entries.zh: 呼音〔义项存疑〕；出声呼叫以试其音
entries.en: to call out to test the sound; sense uncertain
entries.notes: 西语词头 examinar la q nada 残讹不可解，汉字/闽音「呼音」难以与之对合，义项无从定夺

entries.zh: 省问；察问、推问（看其是否合宜）
entries.en: to examine by inquiry; to ask into whether it is right/proper

entries.zh: 设考；设科开考（考试以定等第）
entries.en: to set up an examination (in order to grade/assign rank)

entries.zh: 查后手；追查后手（后续经手、接手之人）
entries.en: to investigate the hands behind; to trace the subsequent handler/party
entries.notes: 西语词头 los llenos en lama- 残讹未完（词尾短横示接下文），释义以汉字「查后手」与闽音为准

entries.zh: 殿试；殿廷御试，科举最高一级，天子亲策
entries.en: palace examination; the final imperial examination held for the highest degree

entries.zh: 科举；科举应试，分科取士之考试
entries.en: imperial civil-service examination (keju); examined so as to gain a degree
entries.notes: 西语 p engenar 残讹，依赖推断展开为「为取功名/等第而应试」

entries.zh: 查有；查明确有、查得有之
entries.en: it is found upon examination; examined and found to exist

entries.zh: 不足算；不算数、不列入计算（摈斥不用）
entries.en: not counted, excluded from the reckoning; rejected as no good
entries.notes: 汉字「算/筦」存疑；闽音栏并列两读（pur chog quan / gui chiog soan），据西语 Excluido por malo 取「不足算」
汉字「印」残损、西语词头 Exedel canso~ 不可解、闽音 cu 孤证，无从定夺
